listed_sector_signals.signal: Lists petrochemical, cement, pulp and paper, glass, and iron and steel industries among the energy-intensive industries (EII) targeted by the proposed energy management framework
listed_sector_signals.quote:
In this paper, the following industrial segments were considered as EII: (i) 
petrochemical industry; (ii) cement industry; (iii) pulp and paper industry; (iv) 
aluminum industry; (v) glass industry; (vi) chemical industry; (vii) iron and steel 
industry.
listed_sector_signals.sector: petrochemicals; cement; pulp & paper; glass; steel and primary metals

listed_sector_signals.signal: Notes that for some industrial processes (petroleum) the EnMS can be considered a primary process
listed_sector_signals.quote:
It should be noted that for some industrial processes 
(petroleum) it can also be considered as the primary process.

other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Aluminum industry listed as an energy-intensive industry
Mentions feasibility of using cogeneration (simultaneous generation of two forms of energy) as an energy-review consideration
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote: the feasibility of using cogeneration (simultaneous generation of two forms of energy).

one_line: The paper proposes and models (in BPMN) a conceptual Energy Management System process based on ISO 50001 for energy-intensive industries in general, naming several continuous-production sectors only as illustrative examples without applying or validating the method in any specific plant.
